name: storyeq-library-connector
description: The library connector bundled into StoryEQ plugins. Carries no library details; each machine keeps its own settings.

scripts.build: esbuild src/server.js --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=dist/library.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cr } from 'node:module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);"
